description: A Perl script for generating Redboot bootloader configuration scripts based on input kernel and root filesystem files. The script calculates memory offsets and sizes, and produces a shell script to initialize and configure the firmware.

methods.name: parse_num
methods.description: Parses a numerical value, interpreting hexadecimal strings starting with '0x' and converting them into numeric values.

methods.name: gen_script
methods.description: Generates a Redboot configuration script file based on the input kernel and root filesystem files, calculating offsets and sizes, and writing commands to initialize firmware.
